Blue Yonder Luminate WM cost

Blue Yonder Luminate WM is the JDA-heritage tier-1 WMS rebuilt as microservices on the Snowflake-backed Luminate platform. Quote-only. Bundles WMS with TMS and labor management to win deals on bundle math rather than per-module list.

[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Quote-only enterprise; bundles WMS with TMS and labor management on Snowflake-backed Luminate platform[s-02].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Bundle scope: Luminate WMS + TMS + Labor + Order Management each priced separately.
  • Microservices subscription scales by warehouse, module, and integration volume.
  • Panasonic ownership (since 2021) has pushed the Cognitive Solutions roadmap deeper.
  • Snowflake consumption is bundled or pass-through depending on tenancy.
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

Panasonic ownership (since 2021) has pushed the Cognitive Solutions roadmap deeper. Microservices-based WMS still rolls out alongside the legacy JDA WMS install base.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • Tier-1 CPG distribution with a TMS-bundle requirement.
  • Omnichannel retail wanting WMS + Labor + DOM in one platform.
  • Existing JDA WMS install base migrating to Luminate WM microservices.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

How does Blue Yonder bundle WMS with TMS and labor?

Bundles are priced as a discount stack against modular list. The Cognitive Solutions roadmap explicitly markets WMS + TMS + Labor as a unit. Standalone WMS is available but the AE will steer toward the bundle.

What does Panasonic ownership mean for pricing?

Panasonic acquired the remaining 80% of Blue Yonder in 2021. Roadmap continuity is good. Pricing posture has not loosened - quote-only remains the default.

Manhattan or Blue Yonder?

See our compare page at /vs/manhattan-vs-blue-yonder. Short answer: Manhattan leads on cloud-native architecture and store fulfillment, Blue Yonder leads on bundle breadth (TMS, Labor, DOM).
